sources.claim: reference_images.formats：官方图片理解文档列出 PNG/JPEG/WEBP/HEIC MIME
sources.quote:
Gemini supports the following image format MIME types:

*   PNG - `image/png`
*   JPEG - `image/jpeg`
*   WEBP - `image/webp`
*   HEIC - `image/heic`

sources.claim: reference_images 含 image/heif：网关转换层 SupportedMimeTypes 明确支持
reference_audios.formats：官方音频文档列出 WAV/MP3 MIME

sources.claim: reference_audios 含 audio/mpeg：网关转换层 IsSupportedMimeType 按 audio/ 前缀接受
